name: Asset Place Landscape and Occupancy View
constraints: Asset Place Landscape is a governed declaration with local artifact identity and Occupancy View is a reproducible projection; neither creates domain identity.
Place, site, facility, building, interior space and movable asset retain separate mastership.
Containment is authored, evidenced and effective-dated and is never inferred from geometry, address or reporting scope.
Occupancy is computed from effective placement and space-use facts at a declared instant and purpose.
Availability is derived for purpose, hours, access, regulatory, hazard and maintenance context and is never a timeless fact.
Placement, custody, title, responsibility, occupancy, availability and maintenance remain separate relations or facts.
Every projection pins source versions, as-of time, viewpoint, disclosure rules and digest.
Generalization and withholding propagate through every projection and prevent reconstruction of finer personal or sensitive locations.
holds: Asset Placement Episode and Operational Responsibility Assignment remain identifier-unassigned candidates.
Independent Grok review, registry reconciliation and one frozen audit remain pending.
